title: Version 26.10.1: good app + how to make it better
body:
BUG: The search-symbol (a magnifying glass) will randomly disappear - it only comes back after the app is restarted

The iPad version makes completed tasks disappear - it should have a line go through them instead, like on the iPhone version, so that you can mark tasks as uncompleted.

PROS:
You can long-press on a time to create an event/task.

The drag-and-drop function makes rescheduling events easy.

Tap on the address of an event and the app will go to Google Maps, which is very useful.

The repeat options are great - for example, you can have it repeat on the third Wednesday of each month, or on the same date.

Display options provide plenty of flexibility: you can choose to see just the day, the week, or the month.

Regular updates to squash bugs and improve the experience.

HOW TO MAKE IT BETTER:
When marking a reminder as “done” it should sync to the iPhone, so that we don’t get a reminder to do something that’s already been done.

Get rid of the “SAVE” button - the app should save automatically, just like other Google apps.

Allow us to add notifications after an event has started, instead of before.

Expand the notification options, so that we can, for example, add a notification 90 minutes before the event.

The icon should show the current day and date, just like Apple’s Calendar app, instead of just saying “31”.

When typing in the search bar, it should show results as you type, without having to type enter.

When creating/editing an event, the “More options” button should be named “repeat options” so that it isn't hidden.

Add the option to add a notification after the event starts - some events go all day and we might want to go there sometime in the middle of the event.

Rename the colours to their normal names: for example, instead of tomato, call it red.

When editing an event to add a notification, show a button to set it at the time of the event - we shouldn’t have to custom-set it to 0 minutes/hours.

Add the duplicate option, which is available for events, to reminders.

Add an undo button for undoing actions like deleting recurring events.

CONCLUSION: A great app, with a little room for improvement - 5 stars.

title: Important feature missing!!!
body:
Just moved over from apple iOS native calendar app, this calendar app is pretty good but is missing a yearly view. Yearly view is useful when planning or checking anything on a yearly scale like holidays, birthdays, rent, work etc. Anything that happens in more than a month’s time it’s much easier to look at the whole thing in one single view. 

Also in monthly view I don’t know why it is scrolled horizontally but scrolling vertically makes more sense as some days from previous and next month’s are visible at the first and last week of the current month, it would be more seamless to scroll up & down and see each month following the other without page breaks. 

Plus this is just something minor but when scrolling, everything except 3 day view snaps to grid and it breaks the continuity of the calendar. In weeks view if I were to, say I am planning a trip or an event over 4 days, if 2 of those days were on next week the whole event would be broken up into 2 “pages”. Of course I can change the start of week day to a day that puts the whole event into the same page but it’s just nicer to scroll around the calendar to adjust the view instead of having to go settings every time.

title: More features needed
body:
Google Calendar is a solid calendar app and perhaps a staple for anyone wanting to organise their events.

However, there are a few essential features needed to make this app more functional.

Firstly, you should have the option to drag and move events to different dates. I’ve had a few situations I needed to do this but you have to manual edit the event date instead.

Secondly, an option to copy dates with a long press. I know there’s a repeat option but there should be easier/more intuitive ways to do this.

Thirdly, more colour options and palettes are needed. The latest redesign is fantastic but I would like to see more colour options such as palettes where you can choose lighter or more pastel colours. The current colours choices can be a bit too saturated. It can be a visual eyesore if you’re a busy person with many events.

body:
It lets you add holidays and change the colour codes for an event. It also is able to display in a Schedule, 1-day, 3-day, Weekly view. 

It's pretty and has all my friends' birthday remembered. I like it so far.

One little feedback which would make this way better than the Apple Calendar app is that if it could show you the actual date on the app icon itself.
author: R3tr0chic

title: Love this App
body: This is the default Calendar App on my iPhone. Love the design. Just waiting for the iPad version
author: ozhero

title: Great app
body: Works well
author: Katehk

title: Great app but...
body: Landscape mode and today's date on the app icon will give this app 5 stars!
author: Gazdawg

title: Love
body: I always hated the calendar that came with the phone because I could never seen what was coming up without having to go through every day. This app just lists everything down in a line. Awesome.
author: Blakedamon

title: Looks pretty but extras would be nice
body:
This calendar app works, it looks nice. Integration of my reservations is great. 
I would love to see support added for the 'Today' view, swipe to edit/delete in Schedule view, the date on the app icon like the native calendar, and to be able switch to weekly view on rotate. I would love to add phone contacts to the 'with...' feature. Adding my own photos to events would be cool.
author: treekalita

title: Landscape mode required
body: Week view would be great in landscape view
author: Moopah

title: Landscape please
body: Love the latest update, especially the 7 day view..... But can we please get the option to tilt the phone and view in landscape in this great app?
author: BJA29

title: Google. Sheesh. Test before release!
body:
It worked 5 minutes ago. 
Update to the current version and it crashes on start. Come on guys, edit. Test. Update App Store. Did someone forget to test it?
author: Mr Moo & Assocs

title: Purely downloading to stop notifications
body: I don't want to use the app and don't care about its features, but it seems to be the only goddamn way to disable those TONS of emails google calendar sends me for all my goddamn events.
author: Shomman

title: Doesn't really work
body: Randomly stops you being able to make new events but will allow other people to update and change shared events, so creates a lot of issues
author: Mbpaleo

title: UI Improvements needed
body:
Display of many daily entries is limited/hampered - when there are many daily entries, there is no view to see just daily or many entries.  What use is a calendar if you can't see all your entries?

Needs to be optimised for iPad
author: GavMan3

title: Nice interface. Bad navigation
body: It is only good for viewing events but bad for making events. Months and day events cannot be viewed simultaneously, month cannot be stickied and this makes it hard to create events to the times that you are free. So I'm still sticking with Apple calendar.
author: Peter11235

title: Wooo hooo
body: Ive been waiting for this lets see how it goes
author: Quantarga

title: Great App
body: The app works and looks great. It integrates well with Exchange and Facebook calendars. I like the "extra" information like pictures and maps that appear in the default event view automatically. It definitely needs the badge icon to display the current date (like the native calendar app), that would make it perfect.
author: Bad M0J0

title: The good and the bad
body:
Looks pretty. Picks up the word dinner from an entry for a nice visual. 

But no week or month view. What the?

No ability to scrunch up the entries to allow more to be visible on the screen. 

Sorry, but sticking to my regular calendar.
author: Greystead

title: Cool interface, needs improvement
body: The app looks great, but the Apple Calendar definitely trumps it for functionality. It needs a full day view (where all the day's events are listed at the bottom), week view and month view. Great start, waiting for it to get better.
author: Subtle Beetroot

title: Missing obvious features
body:
Was really hoping this would replace Apple's app, but this app is missing support for the "today" view when I swipe down from the top of the lock screen (I use this 50 times a day).

It's also missing the one and only feature I was hoping would give me a reason to switch: just like Apple's app, there's no support for booking the meeting rooms I can book when using the desktop web version.
author: justinfrench

title: Smooth, visually appealing, easy to use
body: I would highly recommend getting this app! It's great to use and have so much of your info synced to the app so you don't have to add/alter much.
author: Throwaway14

title: Good start but not quite there
body: Great start to google calendar, but really need week and month views. Hoping to see this in the future. Would also like ability to see Facebook events in the calendar.
author: Moonmaiden333

title: Great app
body: Always love anything from Google. This app is not exceptional. Works well and functional. Thanks google for another great app. Only suggestion, it would be great to have a week view.
author: Apper11apper

title: Add widget please!
body: A good start, but could be better if a calendar widget is added, plus a traditional monthly view.
author: AlanSheep

title: Love it.
body: Yes it's on play store. Thanks google. Works really well and syncs all with my google apps.
author: f2008

title: Good for first version
body:
Could be better.
Needs to pull up contact address from contact list.
Could have a week view.
Still using my old calendar though....
author: DonGrover

title: Great, but needs work...
body:
I really like it. Very smooth and seems less glitchy than the iPhone calendar.
I would love a 7 day view and also the ability to drag appointments to change them rather than needing to go into the edit screen.
author: Lolilun

title: Massive Fan
body:
I am a fan of Google's tools so I was very happy to find out that there was a Google Calendar app for iPhone. This App looks fantastic, runs smoothly and does the work for you. Highlights are:
- great view to see up coming events without clicking too much
- Auto creates a themed graphic depending on keywords like 'dinner' and 'coffee'.
- Shows a Google maps image from the address and links directly to Google maps.
author: Gareth Brown

title: Limited
body: No week or month view! Just 1 or 3 days.
author: FaffyBucket

title: Misleading description
body:
Claims to work with all calendars on the iPhone but doesn't. Doesn't display Facebook events with the default Apple Cal and other calendar apps like Fantastical. 

Not showing all the calendars set up in my iPhone makes this useless.
author: khalido

title: Very good start
body: Good first impression. Today's date/day in the home screen/app icon is missing though.
author: Cricbuff

title: Hallelujah!
body: Finally Google calendar for IOS. I thought I was happy when my kid was born and I got married, this tops them both.
